# ACTINOMYCES SPP.

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See

diagnosis/syndrome section for more information.

For intravenous treatment options, please refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.

# Preferred treatment

[Penicillin VK 500 mg PO QID \($\) R](psozid-penicillin-500mg-po-qid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-penicillin-500mg-po-qid)

<OR>

[Amoxicillin 500 mg PO TID \($\) R](psozid-amoxicillin-500-mg-po-tid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-amoxicillin-500-mg-po-tid)

# Alternative for patients with beta-lactam allergy

[Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID \($\) DI](psozid-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid-doxycycline-100mg-po-bid)
